interface.shortDescription: Recall what your team knows, capture what you learn
interface.longDescription: Reintersect brings your team's memory into the coding agent: it recalls what is already known about this repository, your team and you at the start of a session, captures what the session learns, and exposes Reintersect's tools so the agent can search, remember and forget on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: Recall what my team already knows about this repository
